Zara (CS Ops): Heads-up: healthscore seems skewed for new customers. Playbooks based on health_threshold=0.4 are not triggering for accounts that finished onboarding but didn't have NPS recorded. Thinking: sync onboarding_completion flag and NPS_absent tag into CRM so playbooks can use deterministic rules.

Omar: Makes sense. Do we want a backfill to tag recent accounts that finished onboarding in last 90d?

Zara (CS Ops): Yes 	30d window only. Backfill should only tag accounts where onboarding_completed = true AND nps IS NULL. Tag name: "onboard_done_nps_pending".

Priya: Proposal: 1) create crm_tags_tmp, 2) backfill tags for targeted accounts, 3) run sample playbook matching for those accounts, 4) promote tmp to live. We'll snapshot first. SQL sketch: 
```
UPDATE crm.accounts a
SET crm_tags_tmp = array_distinct(coalesce(a.crm_tags_tmp, '{}') || 'onboard_done_nps_pending')
FROM onboarding o
WHERE o.account_id = a.id AND o.completed_at > now() - interval '90 days' AND a.nps IS NULL;
```

Omar: Also add matcher rule: if tag onboard_done_nps_pending present, treat healthscore OR rule as satisfied for playbooks that check "onboarding_signal". That avoids waiting on NPS.

Zara (CS Ops): Webhook payload for playbook system when tag is added: { account_id, crm_tags, onboarding_completed, sample_nps, event_ts, source:"crm-sync" }. Include optional sample_nps=null.

Priya: We'll debounce tag add events in the sync lambda with a 5m window and include idempotency token to avoid double-tagging from retries. Rate-limit backfill writes to 400/min.

Omar: Can we also add a monitoring card: "% of onboarded accounts with NPS recorded within 14d" and another for "accounts with onboard_done_nps_pending tag"?

Zara (CS Ops): Yes, adding both to the weekly CS ops dashboard. After staging run, I'll validate counts and post 20 sample account ids here.

infra-bot: Maintenance window reserved 2026-06-10 00:30 UTC for swap and promo. :wrench: 

Priya: Plan: staging backfill tonight, deploy matcher/tag-sync to staging, run validation, then prod backfill during maintenance window. I'll post staging diffs in this thread.

Zara (CS Ops): Thanks fingers_crossed. Please ping when samples are up.
